dashboardCharts.name: da4bbad7-22f2-44c6-9ff0-68d22bf8c2ba
dashboardCharts.description: Hourly query counts (Australia/Sydney) for the top 5 domains queried through Pi-hole

dashboardCharts.name: 569d5ff3-e750-45f1-9116-1824f6ef4e12
dashboardCharts.description: Top 5 domains queried through Pi-hole in each hour (Australia/Sydney). Ties for 5th place are included.

dashboardQueries.name: b536d546-ee02-4fbd-995b-2ce203cf0896
dashboardQueries.query:
stage top_domains {
  metadata.log_type = "PIHOLE"
  metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
  $Domain = network.dns.questions.name
  $Domain != ""

  match:
    $Domain

  outcome:
    $Total = count(metadata.id)

  order:
    $Total desc

  limit:
    5
}

metadata.log_type = "PIHOLE"
metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
$Domain = network.dns.questions.name
$Domain = $top_domains.Domain
$Hour = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00", "Australia/Sydney")

match:
  $Hour, $Domain

outcome:
  $Count = count(metadata.id)

order:
  $Hour asc

dashboardQueries.name: 0ce68c65-83ff-4806-b9b2-9d7aad549fe4
dashboardQueries.query:
stage hourly_a {
  metadata.log_type = "PIHOLE"
  metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
  $Domain = network.dns.questions.name
  $Domain != ""
  $Slot = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00", "Australia/Sydney")

  match:
    $Slot, $Domain

  outcome:
    $Cnt = count(metadata.id)
}

stage hourly_b {
  metadata.log_type = "PIHOLE"
  metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
  $Domain = network.dns.questions.name
  $Domain != ""
  $Slot = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00", "Australia/Sydney")

  match:
    $Slot, $Domain

  outcome:
    $Cnt = count(metadata.id)
}

stage ranked {
  $Slot = $hourly_a.Slot
  $Slot = $hourly_b.Slot
  $Domain = $hourly_a.Domain
  $Mine = $hourly_a.Cnt
  $Other = $hourly_b.Cnt

  match:
    $Slot, $Domain

  outcome:
    $Queries = max($Mine)
    $Higher = sum(if($Other > $Mine, 1, 0))
}

$Hour = $ranked.Slot
$Domain = $ranked.Domain
$ranked.Higher < 5

match:
  $Hour, $Domain

outcome:
  $Count = max($ranked.Queries)

order:
  $Hour asc

limit:
  10000
